comment: Integration fixtures for the ONNX -> Core ML conversion path. Point NATIVE_MODEL_ONNX_DIRECTORY at a directory holding these .onnx files (see scripts/fetch_native_test_models.sh) and run `swift test --filter ONNXConversionIntegrationTests`. Expected labels are the top-1 produced by onnxruntime on the given solid-color probe (the independent oracle); a converted model must reproduce them.
